title: Work on my Roulette Roguelike continues (very slowly)
author: olafthemanofsnow
selftext:
Have been working on this for a few months now but I feel like the core gameplay loop is nearly there. 

The concept is that the roulette wheel is your weapon, your chips are your ammo, and as you progress through the casino floors you rig the wheel in your favour, to make sure your bets land.

Still a long long way to go but this has been a really fun project. I obsess over every little detail as I want to push the limits and see whether AI can bring my vision to life.

If anyone has any early comments from the short trailer or would like to try it out, let me know.

comments.author: Varrianda
comments.body: Needs better art. This reads as a casino game rather than a roguelike. You kinda do it with the bosses, but I think everything should try to match that theme
